title: fix(connector-mcp): an include a credentialed MCP server does not list degrades the instance as a credential refusal, not the boot
body:
Fixes #28311
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：MCP 连接器实例发送了凭据、而服务器的 `tools/list` 没有列出 `include` 点名的工具时，不再按“声明错误”让整个服务启动失败，而是按“凭据问题”把该实例降级，存储的凭据标为 `rejected`；没有凭据的实例行为完全不变。
- 为什么改：GitHub 这类服务器按令牌权限过滤工具列表，权限不够的令牌放在环境变量里会让整个运行时下次重启起不来，放在凭据存储里又提示管理员“去修声明”；能修的其实是凭据，而列表本身分不清是“被隐藏”还是“根本没有”，所以提示同时写明两种原因。
- 风险与回滚：只改变“实例发送了 `auth` 凭据且工具缺失”这一种情况的归类，复用已有的 `ConnectorCredentialRejectedError` 与 `rejected` 状态，没有新类型、新状态。回滚即还原 `mcp-provider.ts` 里的 `if (credentialSent)` 分支。
- 先看：`packages/connectors/connector-mcp/src/mcp-provider.ts`（`if (credentialSent)` 分支与 403 的理由）、`packages/connectors/connector-mcp/src/mcp-include-credential-scope.test.ts`（环境变量路径与存储路径两条启动测试）、`content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx`。
- 两分钟验证：依赖闭包构建后运行 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/connector-mcp exec vitest run src/mcp-include-credential-scope.test.ts`，预期 `Tests 9 passed (9)`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/connector-mcp` (`mcp-provider.ts`).** When `providerConfig.include` names a tool the server's `tools/list` does not carry, the refusal now depends on whether the handshake carried the instance's credential (an `http` transport with the instance `auth` sent as a header — the same predicate `credentialVerified` already used):
  - **carried:** `ConnectorCredentialRejectedError`, status `403`. The message names the missing tools, the tools the server lists for that credential, and both causes with the fix for each (the credential lacks the scopes those tools need, or the declaration names a tool the server does not have). The materializer's existing credential path then applies: degraded, boot not failed; a stored credential marked `rejected` and held; an environment or vault credential retried on the backoff.
  - **not carried** (no `auth`, an `api-key` sent as a query parameter, a `stdio` transport, or a credential written into `providerConfig.transport.headers`, which is part of the declaration): the plain configuration fault, byte-identical message, fatal at boot as before.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx`: the `include` paragraph, the "credential the upstream refuses" paragraph and two rows of the failure-mode table. `packages/apps/connector-github/README.md`: the Credentials paragraph no longer says an environment-variable token stops the server from starting.
- **Contract text the change would otherwise make false.** `ConnectorCredentialRejectedError` / `CONNECTOR_CREDENTIAL_REJECTED` TSDoc in `packages/spec` (comments only, no type change) and the `sys_connector_credential.status` field description now name the second way the marker is raised.
- **Tests.** `src/mcp-include-credential-scope.test.ts` (new): the three probes the card was filed from, made permanent on the real provider, the real materializer and the real credential store (ObjectQL over SQLite), plus controls. For the store, `connector-mcp` gains three devDependencies (`@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/driver-sql`, `@objectstack/platform-objects`, all already in its build closure) and a `vitest.config.ts` that reads them from source.
- **Changeset.** `@objectstack/connector-mcp` patch, `@objectstack/service-automation` patch (the field description).

## Tests

At head `b6312fe6`:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/connector-mcp test`: `Test Files 6 passed (6)`, `Tests 65 passed (65)`; `typecheck` exit 0, test-typecheck ledger unchanged (`1 file(s) / 5 error(s)`, the new file adds none).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/connector-app-github test` (validate + vitest): `Validation passed`, `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 10 passed (10)`; `typecheck` exit 0.
- `@objectstack/service-automation` (the description edit), at `c7628191`, no later commit touches it: `Test Files 237 passed (237)`, `Tests 2985 passed (2985)`; `typecheck` exit 0.
- The new file, 9 cases: credentialed refusal (403, both causes, missing and listed tools, client closed, no token in the message); controls — no `auth`, `api-key` as a query parameter, a credential in `transport.headers`, `stdio` with `auth`, and a credential whose listing carries every entry (materializes, `credentialVerified`); through the materializer — environment credential (boot not failed, degraded, listed `rejected` / `env`, not held, recovers on a reconcile once the same token's scopes cover the tools), stored credential (degraded with the credential reason, row `rejected` with that reason, held as `credential`, a reconcile dials nothing, a better-scoped value recovers it with `lastVerifiedAt` set; neither token in any log line; no "Fix its declaration" line), and no credential (boot still fails with the declaration fault).
- **Ablation, once, at `a51f1291`:** `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `if (credentialSent) {` with `if (false as boolean) {` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `05b010b670de` to `2dd4cd2773e3`): `Tests 3 failed | 6 passed (9)`, the three credential-path cases red, every control green; restored, blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports the provider by relative path from `src`, so no build sits between the mutation and the run.

## Acceptance notes

- **Can the server tell the two causes apart? Measured: no.** `github/github-mcp-server` at `f2a07cd1`: the scope filter is applied to the inventory before `tools/list` (`pkg/http/handler.go` `PATScopeFilter`, `pkg/github/scope_filter.go`), the result carries no field about hidden tools, and the HTTP layer sets no scope header on that answer. The only scope signal is `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error="insufficient_scope"` with `403` on a `tools/call` (`pkg/http/middleware/scope_challenge.go`). So the message names both causes, and status `403` follows that same convention (RFC 6750 section 3.1); the message itself quotes no HTTP status.
- **The GitHub app's own two tools are never hidden by GitHub's server.** At `f2a07cd1`, `search_issues` and `issue_read` are declared with `scopes.PublicRead(scopes.Repo)`, whose visibility check returns true for any scopes (`pkg/scopes/scopes.go`, `PublicRead`), matching GitHub's `docs/scope-filtering.md` "Public Repository Access". The defect is reachable with GitHub through other tools (write tools, `notifications`, project and org tools) and with any server that filters by credential. The README paragraph now says so.
- **Row state.** The existing `rejected` state is reused; no new state. It clears when the value is set again or a handshake lists every entry (`markVerified`). A credentialed instance whose `include` has a real typo now marks its stored credential `rejected` too; the message names that cause, and editing the declaration re-attempts it and clears the mark on success.
- **Where the probes live.** In `connector-mcp`'s own tests, which run without the app; `packages/apps/connector-github/test/boot.test.ts` is unchanged.
- `packages/services/service-automation/src/plugin.ts` is not touched. Its hold log line ("its upstream refused its credential") reads acceptably for this case and is left alone.
- `origin/main` was merged at `efdddc90`, after #28306 landed. Main has moved since; GitHub's merge of the newer commits is clean (`git merge-tree` exit 0), and none of them touches these packages.
